The recording begins by launching the submitted build and demonstrates the typical diary, timer, and password-generation workflows, as well as the privacy-policy link.

Prelis Mobile does not require an account and has no registration, login, subscription, or in-app purchase flow. Diary entries and imported timer sounds are private local content, with no posting, sharing, messaging, or interaction with other users. The core features work without an external backend. Features are consistent across distribution regions, and the current interface is Japanese.

The privacy policy is accessible in the app from Home > プライバシーポリシー (Privacy Policy), which opens https://prelis.prj.kupac.co.jp/privacy in the default browser.

For the timer sound demonstration, import the supplied WAV through Timer > 音声設定を開く (Open sound settings) > 音声を追加 (Add audio). Keep the app visible until the one-minute timer completes. Background completion notifications and precisely timed background audio are not provided.

Thank you for reviewing our submission.
